exposure: fertility-preserving surgery (FSS) for early-stage epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC)
cohort: 25 women with a history of stage IA or IC ovarian cancer who had undergone fertility-preserving surgery (FSS)
finding: Pregnancy after fertility preservation in EOC has an excellent perinatal prognosis, with a mean delivery gestational age of 38.7 weeks and low rates of neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was high among the study participants (13 out of 31 deliveries).
